messages.content: Return only JSON matching the schema. Examine category boundaries: deterministic derivation versus model inference, provider output versus customer assay, and EVM commitment versus truth.

Given this mechanism: witnessed token/claim work and capability lots; FCA derives deterministic-service cover; compatible positive-integer ActivityStreams offers are ranked; an EVM Chu-Hoare seam binds the selected provider actor; provider returns a result; a customer-owned assayer independently accepts or withholds it; an effect receipt commits the customer assay; only typed no-cover residue can reach a language model, whose output remains pending customer assay. Finance and keccak256 both close through scripts with zero model calls, and repeated Finance runs assign a witnessed amortization claim to the work-class token. JSON is a replay projection, not authority. State whether the boundaries are preserved and list up to three residual risks. Do not suggest global orchestration or model-first dispatch.

completion.text: {"boundaries_preserved":true,"residual_risks":["Cover-type misclassification: if content that has deterministic cover is incorrectly typed as no-cover residue, it reaches the LLM when it should close deterministically; the filter's correctness is load-bearing and unwitnessed.","Assayer liveness failure treated as acceptance: the customer-owned assayer's independence is structural only if liveness loss (timeout, crash, key loss) does not default to implicit acceptance; a silent-accept fallback would collapse the provider/customer boundary.","Amortization witness lag: if the witnessing of repeated Finance runs trails actual execution — due to reorg, sequencer delay, or batching — capability lots can appear funded against stale amortization claims, creating a window of phantom cover before the next witnessed commit reconciles."]}

residual_risks: Cover-type misclassification: if content that has deterministic cover is incorrectly typed as no-cover residue, it reaches the LLM when it should close deterministically; the filter's correctness is load-bearing and unwitnessed.

Assayer liveness failure treated as acceptance: the customer-owned assayer's independence is structural only if liveness loss (timeout, crash, key loss) does not default to implicit acceptance; a silent-accept fallback would collapse the provider/customer boundary.

Amortization witness lag: if the witnessing of repeated Finance runs trails actual execution — due to reorg, sequencer delay, or batching — capability lots can appear funded against stale amortization claims, creating a window of phantom cover before the next witnessed commit reconciles.
